title: VTG Executive Jewel Box and Game Center Wooden Dice Cards Poker Chips Craps
descriptionText:
Vintage Executive Jewel Box and Game Center wooden case
Copyright 1960
Gold Arrow Import
GRICO Japan
Solid wood box with hinged lid
Interior features a printed craps layout under clear cover
Red felt lined interior compartments
Includes
Poker chips in multiple colors
Playing cards
Dice including red and yellow dice
Original fitted interior layout
Metal plaque on front reads
Executive Jewel Box and Game Center
Condition notes
Wood case shows surface wear, scratches, and age consistent with vintage use
Interior felt shows light wear
Graphics show fading and wear from age
All contents shown in photos are included
Please review photos carefully for exact condition and completeness
Great vintage casino themed game set for display, man cave decor, or collectors of mid century game accessories
